lines.en: label nikispring8:
scene sayanything1
: Please move back into my house and stop convincing my friends to use knife karate on me.
lines.zh: : 请搬回我家，别再怂恿我的朋友对我用「刀法」了。

lines.en: : Sir, I’m afraid I’m going to have to ask you to leave. And to take the floating terms of use with you. You are not supposed to be here.
lines.zh: : 先生，恐怕我得请您离开。还请把那些飘着的使用条款一并带走。您不该出现在这里。

lines.en: : And yet I am. For the only place I truly belong is by the side of my childhood friend.
lines.zh: : 可我确实在这儿。因为我真正属于的唯一一处地方，就是我青梅竹马的身边。

lines.en: : Oooohhh...so {i}that’s{/i} the guy who cheated on her. Wait, really? {i}That’s{/i} who she’s been ranting about all day?
lines.zh: : 哦——所以{i}这就是{/i}那个劈腿她的男人。等等，真的？她一整天都在骂的{i}就是这个人{/i}？

lines.en: : Don’t scoff just yet. It takes a special sort of guy to Say Anything a girl. Plus, if this works out, maybe she’ll actually be able to finish the shoot.
lines.zh: : 先别急着嗤笑。要对着一个姑娘玩「Say Anything」这一套，得是相当特别的人才行。再说，要是这招奏效，她说不定真能把这场拍完。

lines.en: : Niki Nakayama — I am sorry. Please accept this grand gesture and come back to me.
lines.zh: : Niki Nakayama——对不起。请收下这场盛大的告白，回到我身边吧。

lines.en: scene sayanything2
: Did I play the wrong song? This is not the reaction Noriko told me I’d get.
lines.zh: : 我放错歌了吗？Noriko 说我会得到的不是这种反应啊。

lines.en: : I think that’s a pretty reasonable reaction, to be fair.
lines.zh: : 说句公道话，我觉得这反应挺合理的。

lines.en: scene sayanything3
: There’s no way he’s legally allowed to use this song, right?
lines.zh: : 他不可能有合法权利用这首歌吧？

lines.en: : You see, that’s what I thought too. But I reviewed the terms of use he floated in with and it looks like he {i}is{/i} allowed to use it so long as its not for commercial purposes.
lines.zh: : 你看，我也是这么想的。但我审了一遍他飘进来的那些使用条款，看起来只要不是用于商业用途，他{i}是{/i}可以用这首歌的。

lines.en: : Aren’t there limits to fair use, though? Like the amount of time you’re allowed to play a certain song for and how it needs to have some sort of...commentary or satire to it?
lines.zh: : 可合理使用不是有限制吗？比如一首歌能放的时长，还有它需要带点……评论或讽刺性质之类的？

lines.en: : Fair use doesn’t have anything to do with this case since Peter Gabriel Ltd. uploaded the song to a platform that users need to register and pay for.
lines.zh: : 合理使用跟这个案子没关系，因为 Peter Gabriel 公司是把这首歌上传到一个需要用户注册付费的平台上的。

lines.en: : It’s effectively a highly limited single-use license that’s really only valid under very specific circumstances and this just happens to be one of them.
lines.zh: : 这实际上是一种限制极严的单次授权，只在非常特定的情形下有效，而我们这个恰好就是其中之一。

lines.en: : Assuming, of course, that this isn’t real life and that we all live in a sort of Truman Show-esque scenario in which we’re all being constantly watched and broadcast without our knowledge.
lines.zh: : 当然，前提是这不是真实生活，而我们都活在某种《楚门的世界》式的情境里——在毫不知情的情况下被持续观看和转播。

lines.en: : Which would be a much bigger legal issue than just using a forty-year old song anyway, so...
lines.zh: : 而那本来就比用一首四十年前的歌麻烦得多，所以……

lines.en: : Huh...so there’s just nothing we can do to stop him then?
lines.zh: : 嗯……那我们就拿他没办法了？

lines.en: scene sayanything4
: It doesn’t look like it, no. He could carry that boombox around for the rest of his life and we’d have no legal grounds to intervene.
lines.zh: : 看起来是没有。他可以一辈子拎着那台手提音响到处走，我们也找不到法律依据去干预。

lines.en: : Which I may just wind up doing since I don’t know anything else that would be powerful enough to overtake the fact that I am a disgusting, unfaithful, adulterous piece of shit.
lines.zh: : 而我说不定真会那么做——因为我想不出还有什么别的东西，能盖过「我是一坨恶心、不忠、通奸的狗屎」这个事实。

lines.en: : Lloyd Dobler would never.
lines.zh: : Lloyd Dobler 才不会。

lines.en: scene sayanything5
: Have you lost your fucking mind? You really think you can just walk in here and Say Anything me and that I’ll cave and move back into your shitty house? Get bent.
lines.zh: : 你他妈疯了吗？你真以为就这么走进来对我来一套 Say Anything，我就会屈服、搬回你那破房子？做梦。

lines.en: : Noriko told me you might say that. To which I’m supposed to say, “I love that you get cold when it’s 71 degrees out. I love that it takes you an hour and a half to order a sandwich. I love-”
lines.zh: : Noriko 说你可能会这么说。而按她的说法，我该回你：「我爱你在 71 度的时候还会觉得冷。我爱你点个三明治要花一个半小时。我爱——」

lines.en: scene sayanything6
: Knock it off with the 80’s rom-com references! I don’t care how deeply they resonate with my idealized perception of how couples are supposed to be! You fucked my sister!
lines.zh: : 别再拿八十年代爱情喜剧那套台词了！我不管它们多深地戳中了我对「情侣该是什么样」的理想化想象！你睡了我妹妹！

lines.en: : I did. And I am sorry. But being without you in addition to other recent events has made me realize more than anything that I need your help.
lines.zh: : 我睡了。我很抱歉。但没有你在身边，再加上最近发生的那些事，让我比什么都更清楚地意识到——我需要你的帮助。

lines.en: : So much so that I am apparently now willing to do ridiculously embarrassing things like storming into an active commercial shoot and blasting Peter Gabriel for everyone to see and hear.
lines.zh: : 以至于我现在显然愿意做些蠢得要命、丢人现眼的事——比如冲进正在拍摄的广告现场，放着 Peter Gabriel 让所有人看见听见。

lines.en: scene sayanything7

: Which is what you wanted, right? You want everyone to know how sorry I am. How desperate I am. How intensely, pathetically lost and in love with you I am. And how it’s been that way since we were kids.
lines.zh: : 而这正是你想要的，对吧？你想让所有人都知道我有多抱歉。我有多绝望。我是多么强烈、可悲地迷失着、爱着你。还有，从我们还是孩子的时候起，就是如此。

lines.en: : Keep going. And turn that fucking song off.
lines.zh: : 继续。还有，把那首该死的歌关了。

lines.en: : I can’t. I don’t know how many other chances I’ll get to use it and I’m really trying to milk the most out of the license that I possibly can.
lines.zh: : 不行。我不知道还能有多少次机会用上它，我正卯足了劲要把这份授权榨干呢。

lines.en: : Akira, this is the dumbest fucking thing you have ever done.
lines.zh: : Akira，这是你干过最他妈蠢的事。

lines.en: : I agree completely. But you’ve got to admit, it’s unexpected. Right? Which probably earns me some points. Like, this scene would be great in a movie.
lines.zh: : 我完全同意。不过你得承认，这很出人意料。对吧？大概能给我加点分。比如，这场戏放在电影里会很好看。

lines.en: scene sayanything8
: Because it was already in one! And it’s going to take a lot more than cheap tugs at my heartstrings to win me back, you know!
lines.zh: : 因为它本来就已经在一部电影里了！而且想赢回我，光靠这种廉价的煽情可远远不够，你知道吗！

lines.en: : Then tell me what I {i}can{/i} do. Please. Say anything and I’ll do it.
lines.zh: : 那就告诉我{i}该{/i}做什么。拜托。你说什么我都做。

lines.en: : And now you’re name-dropping the title!
lines.zh: : 而你现在连片名都搬出来了！

lines.en: : That one was an accident.
lines.zh: : 那一个是无心的。

lines.en: scene sayanything9
: Niki, I have lived in the palm of your hand for what is essentially my entire life. And yes, I’ve fallen out of it a few times and tried to survive on my own just to fail in the end.
lines.zh: : Niki，我几乎整个一生都活在你的掌心。没错，我几次从那里掉了下去，试着独自活下来，最后都以失败告终。

lines.en: : I want to be done with that, though. I want to be comfortable between your fingers regardless of the damage I will inevitably do to you because {i}that{/i} is where I belong.
lines.zh: : 可我想结束这一切了。我想安稳地待在你的指缝之间，不管我注定会对你造成多少伤害——因为{i}那{/i}才是我该在的地方。

lines.en: : So for once, I’m not running away. I’m running {i}to{/i} you. To apologize for everything. To apologize for what we’ve been through and what we’ll go through, because {i}all{/i} of it is my fault.
lines.zh: : 所以这一次，我不再逃跑。我是奔{i}向{/i}你而来。为我做的一切道歉。为我们经历过的、以及将要经历的一切道歉，因为那{i}全都{/i}是我的错。

lines.en: : And I ask you now to come back to me, knowing full-well that you are better off with someone else who isn’t going to make your life a living hell and that I {i}am{/i} taking advantage of you by doing that.
lines.zh: : 而我现在请求你回到我身边——我完全清楚，你跟一个不会把你的人生变成活地狱的人在一起会更好，而我也清楚，我这么做{i}是在{/i}利用你。

lines.en: : But I don’t care. That’s how selfish I am. I must have you by any means necessary because I can not escape the hole I’ve fallen into without your help.
lines.zh: : 可我不在乎。我就是这么自私。我必须不惜一切代价拥有你，因为没有你的帮助，我爬不出我掉进的那个洞。

lines.en: : In your eyes, I am complete.
lines.zh: : 在你的眼里，我才是完整的。

lines.en: scene sayanything10
: That one was on purpose.
lines.zh: : 那一个是故意的。

lines.en: scene sayanything11
: Patrice! I’m taking the day off!
lines.zh: : Patrice！我今天请假！

lines.en: : But...Niki, you’re in the middle of a shoot. You have one line left.
lines.zh: : 可是……Niki，你正在拍摄中。你只剩一句台词了。

lines.en: : {i}And{/i} the English version...
lines.zh: : {i}还有{/i}英文版……

lines.en: : I don’t care! I’m a celebrity and my mental health is important. Come on, Lloyd. You have some more groveling to do.
lines.zh: : 我不在乎！我是名人，我的心理健康很重要。走吧，Lloyd。你还有得跪求呢。

lines.en: : Yes, ma’am. But I’m keeping the song on.
lines.zh: : 遵命，女士。不过歌我继续放着。

lines.en: scene black
: Fine. But when you inevitably draw the attention of every fucking person we encounter, you must tell them you are my slave. Do you understand?
lines.zh: : 行。可等你不可避免地招来我们遇到的每一个该死的人的注意时，你必须告诉他们，你是我的奴隶。明白吗？

lines.en: : Yes. I am entirely ready to be emasculated for the indefinite future. This is just one more example of how serious I am.
lines.zh: : 明白。我已经完全准备好在无限期的未来里被去势。这只是又一个例子，说明我有多认真。

lines.en: : Uhh...I...I guess we’re done? We’re still getting paid for today, right?
lines.zh: : 呃……我……我们算收工了吗？今天的钱还是照给的吧？

lines.en: : {i}Hah...{/i}I really hope so...
lines.zh: : {i}哈……{/i}我真希望是……

lines.en: scene sky
I follow Niki out of the studio and hop into a taxi she charters, bound for...some sort of emotionally relevant location, I’m sure.
lines.zh: 我跟着 Niki 走出摄影棚，跳上她包下的一辆出租车，驶向……某个情感上有意义的地点，我敢肯定。

lines.en: if amispring5 == True:
And while I can’t tell if the strategy I devised with Noriko following the events of a certain drugging in my house the other day is working, I’m trying to remain positive.
lines.zh: 虽然我说不准，那天在我家发生的某起迷奸事件之后，我和 Noriko 一起设计的策略是否奏效，我仍在努力保持乐观。

lines.en: Which is a crazy thing to do after your daughter kidnaps a girl and tries to make you have sex with her, but it’s something I {i}need{/i} to do if I want to have any hope of fixing this.
lines.zh: 在你的女儿绑架了一个女孩、还试图逼你跟她上床之后还保持乐观，这很疯狂。可如果我还想有哪怕一丝修补这一切的希望，我就{i}必须{/i}这么做。

lines.en: else:
And while I can’t tell if the strategy I devised with Noriko the other day is working, I’m trying to remain positive.
lines.zh: 虽然我说不准，那天我和 Noriko 设计的策略是否奏效，我仍在努力保持乐观。

lines.en: Which is a crazy thing to do when you have a daughter you don't feel safe sleeping in the same house with, but it’s something I {i}need{/i} to do if I want to have any hope of getting to that point.
lines.zh: 当你有个让你觉得连睡在同一屋檐下都不安全的女儿时，这很疯狂。可如果我还想有哪怕一丝希望走到那一步，我就{i}必须{/i}这么做。

lines.en: Because yes, history shows that having Niki around does not exactly make Ami more sane. But it makes her {i}something.{/i}
lines.zh: 因为，没错，过往的事实表明，有 Niki 在身边并不能让 Ami 变得更正常。但它让她变成了{i}「某种东西」{/i}。

lines.en: And I think the answer to that is far more complicated than just “angry that Niki doesn’t support incest.” I’m sure intimidation is a part of it, though.
lines.zh: 而我觉得，答案远比「气 Niki 不支持乱伦」要复杂得多。不过我敢肯定，恐吓是其中的一部分。

lines.en: Because that’s how it is for Maya and, as much as I hate saying it, Ami isn’t all that different from her at the end of the day. They both {i}fear{/i} Niki because they both know how important she is to me.
lines.zh: 因为对 Maya 来说就是这样，而尽管我讨厌这么说，Ami 到头来跟她并没有那么不同。她们都{i}怕{/i} Niki，因为她们都知道她对我有多重要。

lines.en: Does {i}Niki{/i} know that, though?
lines.zh: 可 {i}Niki{/i} 知道这一点吗？

lines.en: Because, if not, I hope she will by the end of the day. Just like I hope that the end of the day is the start of something new.
lines.zh: 因为如果她不知道，我希望在今天结束之前她能明白。就像我也希望，今天的结束会是某件新事物的开始。

lines.en: Anyway, we’ve arrived at the emotionally relevant location. And I have some work to do, so...
lines.zh: 总之，我们到了那个情感上有意义的地点。而我还有活要干，所以……

lines.en: Goodbye for now.
lines.zh: 暂时别过。

lines.en: And wish me luck.
lines.zh: 祝我好运吧。

lines.en: scene sayanything12
: Ugh...I can’t believe you fucking Say Anything’ed me at work. Where the fuck did you even {i}get{/i} a boombox? Did Noriko help with {i}that{/i} too?
lines.zh: : 呃……我真不敢信你他妈的在我上班的时候对我来这套 Say Anything。你到底从哪{i}弄来{/i}的手提音响？Noriko 也帮了忙？

lines.en: : She did. But I sort of {i}needed{/i} her help if I was ever going to appeal to you since we both know how colossally I have fucked up this time.
lines.zh: : 是她。不过我要想打动你，多少{i}得靠{/i}她帮忙——毕竟我们俩都清楚，这次我搞砸得有多离谱。

lines.en: : Yes, it was an expertly executed one-two punch having her soften me up so you could storm in and deliver the killing blow. Oh, how happy I am to see how much chemistry you two have.
lines.zh: : 是啊，配合得真专业——先让她把我软化，你再冲进来补上致命一击。哦，看到你们俩这么默契，我可真是太高兴了。

lines.en: : Niki...I don’t know how many times I can apologize for doing what I did with her, but I am more than willing to stand here and find the answer if you want me to.
lines.zh: : Niki……我不知道自己能为对她做的事道歉多少次，但只要你愿意，我非常乐意站在这儿，一直找到那个答案。

lines.en: : No amount of apologizing is going to fix or even {i}explain{/i} what you did, Akira. But we both know it doesn’t fucking matter anyway because I exist to be taken advantage of by you.
lines.zh: : 再怎么道歉也弥补不了、甚至{i}解释不了{/i}你的所作所为，Akira。可我们俩都知道那根本不重要——因为我存在的意义，就是被你利用。

lines.en: : Take advantage of me too, then. Please. Whatever it takes to win you back, I’ll do it.
lines.zh: : 那也利用我吧。拜托。只要能赢回你，我什么都做。

lines.en: scene sayanything13
: You can start by putting the boombox down.
lines.zh: : 你可以先把那台手提音响放下。

lines.en: scene sayanything14
: Do I really have to?
lines.zh: : 我真得放吗？

lines.en: : You’re actually starting to like this song, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你其实开始喜欢上这首歌了，是吧？

lines.en: : I think, based on context, this is officially {i}our{/i} song. Which is great since we were pretty overdue for one.
lines.zh: : 我觉得，结合上下文，这首歌正式成为「{i}我们的{/i}歌」了。这很好，因为我们早就该有一首了。

lines.en: : {i}Hah...{/i}fucking romantic comedies. Of all the moves for you to pull, it had to be that. Noriko knows her shit.
lines.zh: : {i}哈……{/i}该死的爱情喜剧。那么多招数你不选，偏偏选了这个。Noriko 可真懂。

lines.en: : I had no idea you even liked them that much.
lines.zh: : 我都不知道你这么喜欢那类电影。

lines.en: : Yeah, because you’re a selfish piece of shit who’s {i}never{/i} paid much attention to me while I’ve been fucking obsessed with you ever since we met.
lines.zh: : 是啊，因为你就是坨自私的狗屎，{i}从来{/i}没怎么注意过我——而我他妈的从认识你那天起就对你着了魔。

lines.en: scene sayanything15
: What took you so long?...Idiot.
lines.zh: : 你怎么这么久才来？……白痴。

lines.en: : Stubbornness. Lack of direction. And more misunderstanding you in thinking that you’d be able to function on {i}your{/i} own despite our clear co-dependence.
lines.zh: : 犟。没有方向。还有就是又一次误判了你——以为尽管我们明显互相依赖，你还是能{i}自己{/i}撑下去。

lines.en: : I’m still alive, aren’t I?
lines.zh: : 我不是还活着吗？

lines.en: : Yeah, but if it’s anything like the sort of “alive” I am, it probably doesn’t feel like you are. And you’re probably tired of waking up alone.
lines.zh: : 是啊，可如果那跟我那种「活着」差不多，大概你自己也感觉不到自己活着。而你大概也厌倦了独自醒来。

lines.en: : Why am I like this? Do I have Stockholm Syndrome or something? How come you can keep doing terrible things to me just to somehow win me back in the end? I don’t consent to this.
lines.zh: : 我怎么会变成这样？我得了斯德哥尔摩综合征还是什么？为什么你一再做那些可怕的事，最后却总有办法把我赢回去？我可没同意过。

lines.en: : I’m sure I’d be the same way if you ever did anything terrible to me. You just won’t because you’re a good person and I’m not.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定，要是你对我做过什么可怕的事，我也会是一样的。只是你不会——因为你是好人，而我不是。

lines.en: : You’re the actual worst person I’ve ever met. My life would be irrefutably better if we never crossed paths. If you never made me fall for you.
lines.zh: : 你是我见过最糟糕的人。如果我们从没相遇，我的人生毫无疑问会好得多。要是你从没让我爱上你。

lines.en: : How did I do that in the first place? Like, I still don’t understand. Even those people in the studio took one look at me and thought you were insane.
lines.zh: : 你到底是怎么做到的？说真的，我到现在都不明白。连摄影棚里那些人看了我一眼，都觉得你疯了。

lines.en: : I’ll let you know if I ever figure it out. For now, I’ll remain hopeless, confused, and furious at where I’ve ended up {i}again{/i} despite how many times I told myself I wouldn’t this time.
lines.zh: : 等我想明白了会告诉你的。目前，我只能继续绝望、困惑、并且愤怒于自己{i}又一次{/i}落到这步田地——尽管我告诉过自己多少次，这次不会了。

lines.en: : Come home, Niki.
lines.zh: : 回家吧，Niki。

lines.en: : Your home was never {i}mine.{/i} Ami made sure of that. And even if you’re helpless without me, it doesn’t change the fact that {i}she{/i} doesn’t want me there.
lines.zh: : 你的家从来就不是{i}我的家{/i}。Ami 确保了这一点。而且就算没有我你就活不下去，也改变不了{i}她{/i}不想让我待在那儿的事实。

lines.en: : Nor am I all that excited to deal with the {i}next{/i} girl I catch you having sex with, since Noriko surely won’t be the last.
lines.zh: : 我也不太期待去对付{i}下一个{/i}被我撞见你跟她上床的女孩——因为 Noriko 肯定不会是最后一个。

lines.en: : She’ll be the most painful, though. So at least we’ve gotten that out of the way.
lines.zh: : 不过她会是最痛的那个。所以至少这一关我们已经过了。

lines.en: : Hooraaaaay. Things can only go up from here...
lines.zh: : 好——耶。往后的日子只会越来越好……

lines.en: : Just tell me what I can do. Really. What other movies do you like that I can embarrass myself by acting out in public?
lines.zh: : 就告诉我该做什么吧。真的。你还喜欢哪些电影，我可以在公共场合演出来丢人现眼？

lines.en: : As much as I’d love to just give you a list of things you can do to make me okay with dating again, I can’t. I don’t know if I can get there, Akira. I...need more time. I need...{i}something.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我倒是真想直接给你列个清单，让你照做就能让我重新接受跟你交往，可我做不到。我不知道自己能不能走到那一步，Akira。我……需要更多时间。我需要……{i}某样东西{/i}。

lines.en: : I just don’t know what it is. Nor do I imagine you’d be able to give it to me when your actions always revolve around you instead of me.
lines.zh: : 我只是不知道那是什么。我也不觉得你能给我——因为你的所作所为，永远绕着你自己转，而不是绕着我。

lines.en: : I know. And I’m not pretending they don’t. That’s why I said this is selfish. But maybe in taking advantage of your feelings for me {i}again,{/i} you {i}will{/i} think of something.
lines.zh: : 我知道。我也没装作它们不是这样。所以我才说这很自私。但也许在我{i}再次{/i}利用你对我的感情的过程中，你{i}会{/i}想到点什么。

lines.en: : It’s starting to sound like you’re trying to force me to be with you. Which is basically the opposite of our last conversation, so please forgive me if I’m not really {i}getting{/i} it.
lines.zh: : 这听着越来越像你在逼我跟在一起。这跟我们上次谈话的内容基本相反，所以如果我不太{i}明白{/i}，还请见谅。

lines.en: : I don’t know how much more simple I can make it than, “I love you. Please love me back.”
lines.zh: : 除了「我爱你。请你也爱我。」之外，我不知道还能说得更简单多少。

lines.en: scene sayanything16
: I {i}do.{/i} I hate it, but I do. Can {i}anyone{/i} love someone so much that they can just overlook constant betrayal, though?
lines.zh: : {i}我爱{/i}。我恨这样，可我爱。可这世上有{i}谁能{/i}爱一个人爱到，可以对无休止的背叛视而不见呢？

lines.en: : If anyone can, it’s you.
lines.zh: : 如果有谁能，那就是你。

lines.en: : And that’s supposed to make me feel {i}better?{/i} You’re not even {i}pretending{/i} that you’re going to try and stop. You’re asking me to walk face-first into a life of permanent disloyalty.
lines.zh: : 而这就能让我{i}好受些{/i}？你甚至都不{i}装装样子{/i}说你会试着停下来。你是在要我把脸迎上去，走进一段永远不忠的人生。

lines.en: : Why in a million fucking years would I ever do that, Akira? Especially when you’re expecting me to compete with my fucking {i}sister{/i} of all people?
lines.zh: : 我凭什么要那么做，Akira？尤其在你还指望我跟——所有人里偏偏是我——{i}亲妹妹{/i}竞争的时候？

lines.en: : I’m not asking you to {i}compete{/i} with anyone. That’s not fair to {i}them{/i} since you’d win every time.
lines.zh: : 我没有要你跟任何人{i}竞争{/i}。那对{i}她们{/i}不公平，因为你每次都会赢。

lines.en: scene sayanything17
: Stroke my ego as much as you want. It’s not going to bring us any closer to a reunion.
lines.zh: : 你想怎么捧我都行。这不会让我们离复合更近一步。

lines.en: : It’s true, though. Like, I imagine that’s a bigger part of why Ami kept pushing you away than the whole issue with replacing her mom.
lines.zh: : 可这是真的。比如说，我猜那比「取代她妈妈」这件事更能解释，为什么 Ami 一直把你往外推。

lines.en: : Maybe. But I’m not even going to pretend to understand that girl anymore, so there’s no point in discussing her either.
lines.zh: : 也许吧。可我连装都不想再装作能理解那个女孩了，所以也没什么好谈的。

lines.en: : There’s no point in trying to understand her at all when you’d be better off just putting her in her place. That’s what I’ve been trying to pivot to lately.
lines.zh: : 根本没必要去理解她，你倒不如直接让她认清楚自己的位置。我最近正打算转向这个方向。

lines.en: : So what? You just need an extra babysitter? Is that it?
lines.zh: : 所以呢？你只是需要多一个保姆？就这样？

lines.en: : No, I need a girl who can handle emotional manipulation and layer after layer of abuse that would make even the most sane of human beings crumble.
lines.zh: : 不，我需要一个能扛得住情感操控、扛得住一层又一层的虐待的姑娘——那种足以让最清醒的人也崩溃的虐待。

lines.en: scene sayanything18
: Well, at least you’re being honest about it. So thanks for throwing my hat into the ring of fire, I guess.
lines.zh: : 嗯，至少你在这件事上还算诚实。那就谢谢你把我的帽子扔进火圈里了，我想。

lines.en: : It’s not just your hat. It’s your entire body. But I’ll be right there with you and the two of us can go up in a blaze of glory together while gasoline rains down on us from clouds of malice.
lines.zh: : 不只是你的帽子。是你整个人。但我会陪在你身边，我们两个可以一起在荣耀的烈焰中升天，而恶意的云层会往我们身上浇下汽油。

lines.en: : The tone of this conversation no longer fits Peter Gabriel. Why should we have to suffer like that when we could honestly just run away together and be happier that way?
lines.zh: : 这段对话的调子已经配不上 Peter Gabriel 了。既然我们大可以干脆私奔、那样反而更幸福，为什么非得受这种罪？

lines.en: : Because those clouds are following me. They have been since I was a kid. And if I’m ever going to be the man you want me to be, one who can {i}actually{/i} make you happy, I need to be reborn in flames.
lines.zh: : 因为那些云跟着我。从我还是个孩子的时候就跟着了。而如果我想成为你希望我成为的那个人——一个{i}真正{/i}能让你幸福的人，我就必须在烈焰中重生。

lines.en: scene sayanything19
: I love you, Niki. Even when everything I do seems to prove the opposite. So please, witness my self-immolation and inevitably burn off your flesh while trying to extinguish me.
lines.zh: : 我爱你，Niki。即使我所做的一切似乎都在证明相反的事。所以拜托，请你见证我的自焚——然后在试图扑灭我的时候，不可避免地把自己的皮肉也烧掉。

lines.en: : This is the worst sales pitch I have ever heard. You’re very lucky I want to see you on fire right now or I would have already stopped listening.
lines.zh: : 这是我听过最烂的推销词。你运气好，我现在正想看你烧起来，不然我早就不听了。

lines.en: : I’ll let you light the first match if it helps convince you to give me another shot.
lines.zh: : 如果这能说服你再给我一次机会，第一根火柴由你来划。

lines.en: : Are you going to keep cheating on me, Akira?
lines.zh: : 你还会继续出轨吗，Akira？

lines.en: : No non-answers or trying to dodge the question. Just give me a yes or no. That’s it.
lines.zh: : 不许含糊其辞，也不许回避问题。就给我一个是或不是。就这样。

lines.en: : Yes. I am.
lines.zh: : 会。我会。

lines.en: : Mm.
: That’s what I thought.
lines.zh: : 我就知道。

lines.en: : It’s not...how it sounds, though. And I know it {i}sounds{/i} horrible, but I don’t think I’ll {i}always{/i} be this way.
lines.zh: : 可这……不像听起来那样。我知道这{i}听着{/i}很糟，但我不觉得自己{i}永远{/i}都会是这样。

lines.en: : And I’m supposed to just believe that? That you’ll just magically change for the better one day? Because that’s way too optimistic for even me.
lines.zh: : 而我就该信这个？信你某天会奇迹般地变好？因为就连我都觉得这太乐观了。

lines.en: : No, I just...there’s a catalyst somewhere out there. Something I don’t know yet, but...it’s something in the back of my mind. Constantly telling me that there’s a life after this where things are {i}good.{/i}
lines.zh: : 不，我只是……某个地方存在一个契机。某件我还不知道的事，但……它就在我脑海深处，不断告诉我，这一切之后还有一种生活，在那里面一切都{i}很好{/i}。

lines.en: : I can sense it somewhere in the depths of my dreams. I have...what feels like {i}memories{/i} of it in the middle of the day.
lines.zh: : 我能在梦境深处的某个地方感觉到它。我……在大白天里会有那种感觉像是关于它的{i}记忆{/i}。

lines.en: : And yes, that may sound crazy, but there are a million {i}other{/i} things I could tell you that would sound even crazier because this world is nothing but vibrantly colored madness.
lines.zh: : 是啊，这听着可能很疯，但我还能{i}再{/i}告诉你一百万件听起来更疯的事——因为这个世界本身就只是一团色彩鲜艳的疯狂。

lines.en: : And you think it’s possible that, after all the suffering and everything else that happens, there’s a {i}chance{/i} you and I could have a life of our own. Is that it?
lines.zh: : 而你认为，在所有的苦难和即将发生的一切之后，你和我仍{i}有可能{/i}拥有属于我们自己的生活。是这个意思吗？

lines.en: : That’s it.
lines.zh: : 就是这个意思。

lines.en: : And I’m supposed to buy into that and struggle now in hopes that you’re right?
lines.zh: : 而我就该买账，现在先受苦，只盼你是对的？

lines.en: : I’ll do my best to limit the struggling part, but yes. That’s it.
lines.zh: : 我会尽最大努力减少受苦的部分，不过，是的。就是这个意思。

lines.en: : Hm.
: Any questions?
lines.zh: : 有问题吗？

lines.en: : Many. But before I waste any more time asking them, I just want it to be known that I have put my faith in you so many times, Akira. And that I’ve been let down every single one of them.
lines.zh: : 有很多。但在我继续浪费时间问之前，我只想说清楚一件事：我把信任交给你太多次了，Akira。而每一次，你都让我失望。

lines.en: : All I’ve ever {i}had{/i} has been hope that things would be different someday. So there’s no point in trying to sell me that philosophy when it’s all I know in the first place.
lines.zh: : 我一向{i}拥有{/i}的全部，就是「总有一天会不一样」的希望。所以试图向我推销这套哲学毫无意义——因为它本来就是我唯一知道的东西。

lines.en: : Well, what then? There has to be {i}something{/i} I can do to get you back. Just name it.
lines.zh: : 那么，然后呢？一定有{i}什么{/i}是我能做、好让你回来的。说吧。

lines.en: : Don’t just look at me like that...It’s torture.
lines.zh: : 别就那样看着我……这是折磨。

lines.en: : Good. I hope this is what you see every time you close your eyes. Every time you share your “love” with someone else when it’s supposed to belong to me.
lines.zh: : 很好。我希望你每次闭上眼睛，看到的就是这个。每次你把本该属于我的「爱」分给别人时，看到的就是这个。

lines.en: : It will one day. We just need to get out of here. And I need {i}you{/i} to trust me.
lines.zh: : 总有一天会的。我们只需要离开这里。而我需要{i}你{/i}相信我。

lines.en: : Well, I can tell you now that’s not going to happen.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我现在就可以告诉你，那不可能。

lines.en: scene sayanything20
: But...
lines.zh: : 不过……

lines.en: : But?
lines.zh: : 不过什么？

lines.en: : I suppose if I can make {i}you{/i} suffer like I have...
lines.zh: : 我想，如果我能让{i}你{/i}像我一样受苦……

lines.en: : I might be willing to come live in your stupid house again.
lines.zh: : 我也许愿意再搬回你那破房子里住。

lines.en: : I left my favorite mug there, so...I’ve been meaning to go back anyway.
lines.zh: : 我把最喜欢的杯子落那儿了，所以……反正我也一直想回去。

lines.en: : Suffer...how, exactly? What do you want me to do? What will {i}you{/i} do?
lines.zh: : 受苦……具体怎么个受法？你想让我做什么？{i}你{/i}会做什么？

lines.en: : I have a few ideas. All designed to make your life a living hell. And if you thought I was overbearing before, you haven’t seen anything yet.
lines.zh: : 我有几个点子。全都是为了让你的生活变成活地狱。而如果你以前觉得我专横，那还没见识过呢。

lines.en: : You’re a lot of things, but...I don’t think {i}overbearing{/i} is one of them.
lines.zh: : 你身上有很多标签，不过……我不觉得{i}「专横」{/i}是其中之一。

lines.en: : Let’s see how long you believe that for when I’m making every single girl who so much as {i}speaks{/i} to you understand that you are my property.
lines.zh: : 那就看看，当我让每一个哪怕只是跟你{i}说话{/i}的姑娘都认清「你是我的财产」时，你还能这么想多久。

lines.en: : Can I ask...how you intend to do that, exactly? Or is this just going to be a surprise?
lines.zh: : 我能问……你具体打算怎么做吗？还是说这要留个惊喜？

lines.en: scene sayanything21

: It’ll be a surprise. But I have other conditions too. And I expect you to serve me and fulfill every single desire I have from now until this future you claim we’ll have one day. Do I make myself clear?
lines.zh: : 是个惊喜。不过我还有别的条件。我要你服侍我、满足我的每一个欲望，从现在起，一直到你所宣称的、我们终将拥有的那个未来。我说清楚了吗？

lines.en: : Type me up a list and I’ll frame it on every wall in my house so I’m forced to remember.
lines.zh: : 你打一份清单给我，我裱起来挂在我家每一面墙上，好让自己不得不记住。

lines.en: : You’d be better off tattooing it on your arm so you don’t conveniently forget the second you leave. Does that work for you?
lines.zh: : 你还不如把它纹在手臂上，免得一出门就「恰好」忘了。这样你行吗？

lines.en: : Sure. So long as the tattoo won’t bother you.
lines.zh: : 当然。只要那个纹身不会碍着你的眼。

lines.en: : You’re really serious then?
lines.zh: : 那你是认真的？

lines.en: : Of course I’m serious.
lines.zh: : 我当然是认真的。

lines.en: : You really {i}do{/i} want me back?
lines.zh: : 你真的{i}想{/i}让我回来？

lines.en: : I {i}need{/i} you back. It’s not just “wanting.” I was a fool for ever thinking I could live without you. And I don’t want you to be sad on your own anymore.
lines.zh: : 我{i}需要{/i}你回来。不只是「想」。我竟以为没有你也能活，真是个傻瓜。而我不想再让你一个人难过了。

lines.en: : If you’re mad at me, I want to fight about it. If I upset you, I want to see the look on your face when you’re crying. If I’m disloyal, I want you to make me feel like shit.
lines.zh: : 你生我的气，我想跟你吵。我惹你不高兴，我想看见你哭时的表情。我不忠，我要你让我觉得自己是坨屎。

lines.en: : I want you to make me a better person, Niki. Even if it feels like it’s not worth the time or the effort, which we both know it’s probably not.
lines.zh: : 我想让你把我变成更好的人，Niki。哪怕这看起来不值得花那些时间精力——而我们俩都知道，大概确实不值。

lines.en: : Come here. And put the fucking boombox down.
lines.zh: : 过来。还有，把那该死的音响放下。

lines.en: : Am I...uhh...Is the part where I kiss your feet?
lines.zh: : 我……呃……是不是该亲你的脚了？

lines.en: : Just fucking come over here, idiot.
lines.zh: : 你他妈的给我过来，白痴。

lines.en: scene sayanything22
: Okay, but...what’s going on exactly?
lines.zh: : 好，可是……这到底是在干什么？

lines.en: : I’ve had the same phone wallpaper for years now and I would like to finally change it if I’m going to be entering yet another miserable arc of my shitty relationship with my shitty childhood friend.
lines.zh: : 我手机壁纸好多年没换过了。既然我又要进入跟我那该死的青梅竹马之间这段该死的关系的新一段悲惨篇章，我想干脆换一张。

lines.en: : We’re...back together then? The Say Anything worked?
lines.zh: : 那我们……和好了？Say Anything 那招奏效了？

lines.en: : I don’t want to say we’re “back together.” Just that I enjoy how desperate you are now and that I’d like to see more of that.
lines.zh: : 我可不想说我们「和好了」。只能说，我喜欢你现在这副绝望的样子，还想多看一些。

lines.en: : I’ll be staying at your place tonight. And I expect the lock on your door to be changed by the time I get there so I don’t have to worry about your twisted fucking daughter killing me in my sleep.
lines.zh: : 今晚我住你那儿。而且我希望我到的时候，你家门上的锁已经换好了，省得我还要担心你那个扭曲的该死女儿在我睡着时杀了我。

lines.en: scene sayanything23
: I don’t know how to change a lock, but I can figure it out if it brings you home.
lines.zh: : 我不会换锁，但如果这能让你回家，我可以学着弄。

lines.en: : Just shut the fuck up and look at the camera.
lines.zh: : 你他妈的闭嘴，看镜头。

lines.en: scene sayanything24
: Okay...but if you send this to Ami before I have a chance to warn her that her life is about to get harder again-
lines.zh: : 好……不过如果你在我有机会提醒 Ami「她的日子又要难过起来」之前就把这张发出去——

lines.en: : Do you really think you’re in the position to be trying to talk me out of literally {i}anything{/i} right now, Akira?
lines.zh: : 你真觉得自己现在有立场来劝我放弃{i}任何事{/i}吗，Akira？

lines.en: : You are nothing but a pathetic puppet who will dance on my strings and go along with everything I say for the rest of forever. Smile.
lines.zh: : 你不过是个可悲的木偶，会在我的提线上跳舞，在永世里对我说的每一句话言听计从。笑。

lines.en: : Uhh...ch...cheese?
lines.zh: : 呃……茄……茄子？

lines.en: scene white
scene sayanything25
: Oh, Niki...You pathetic, lovesick moron.
lines.zh: : 哦，Niki……你这个可悲的、害了相思病的傻瓜。

lines.en: : You have no clue what you just signed up for, do you?...
lines.zh: : 你根本不知道自己刚刚签下了什么，对吧？……

lines.en: : It’s almost like you {i}enjoy{/i} suffering.
lines.zh: : 简直就像你很{i}享受{/i}受苦一样。

lines.en: : And yet...
lines.zh: : 可话说回来……

lines.en: scene black
scene sayanything26
: The suffering has only just begun...
lines.zh: : 苦难才刚刚开始……
